highlights: 326 saved/global configuration checks, 30 effective HTTP INI values and all 25 native account limits matched. Four PHP coordinators and their private health masters were active.
Final direct-origin bursts: 16/16 in 21.647s, 32/32 in 29.655s and 64/64 in 59.424s. No HTTP 503, curl failure, database/critical error or OOM kill.
Final operator-network requests through Cloudflare: 16/16 in 28.377s and 32/32 in 53.628s. All responses were DYNAMIC, not HTML cache hits.
A warm product request cached 4910 scripts and used about 164 MiB of the 256-MiB OPcache region.
Three native account probes passed with waits up to about 44s. Grants release when idle; busy pools are not hot-resized. An earlier quiescent check found zero leases.
The earlier short-deadline/public timeout run is retained in the evidence. Passing bounded retests does not promise zero network timeouts or sustained visitor capacity.
